description: CCP load balancing and TDMA vectors with independent math oracles (hash_32, drift calc from spec).

vectors.name: tdma_slot_assignment_static_hash
vectors.description: Static slot from EUI-64 hash_32(FNV-1a32 basis 0x811c9dc5 per spec/02a-coordinated-capacity.md:123) mod num_slots per TDMA spec (CCP-15.8.3). Independent external arithmetic oracle.

vectors.name: guard_time_boundary_sf10
vectors.description: 50ms guard for 250ms slot tolerates 0.5% drift over 5s superframe.

vectors.name: drift_compensation_two_beacons
vectors.description: Offset correction from beacon arrival times for clock drift compensation.

vectors.name: ccp_load_high_util_rebalance
vectors.description: Load score triggers channel rebalance and TDMA slot reassignment when util>0.4.

vectors.name: select_channel_standard
vectors.description: select_channel() with density=3 < 8, EUI64=0011223344556677, epoch=12345, nchannels=8. Expected=1+(FNV1A32(EUI64||epoch_LE)%8)=5. Independent external arithmetic oracle per spec/02a-coordinated-capacity.md:122-128.

vectors.name: select_channel_density_fallback
vectors.description: select_channel() with density=9 > 8 falls back to channel 0 (control). Independent oracle.

vectors.name: select_channel_min_nchannels
vectors.description: select_channel() with nchannels=1, N=max(1,3)=3. EUI64=aabbccdd00112233, epoch=99999, density=2. Expected=1+(FNV1A32(data)%3)=2. Independent oracle.

vectors.name: select_channel_high_epoch
vectors.description: select_channel() with epoch=0xFFFFFFFF (modular edge case). EUI64=deadbeefcafebabe, density=5, nchannels=16. Expected=1+(FNV1A32(data)%16)=16. Independent oracle.
